7a7e00f5-a4ba-4e9f-9d06-ae98c0cea906.description: A colossal, ornate pyramid-city floating majestically amidst a vast expanse of fluffy white clouds. The multi-tiered pyramid, predominantly colored a rich crimson red, is lavishly adorned with intricate golden detailing, friezes, and statues. A grand, golden inclined pathway leads up its front face, culminating in a radiant golden archway, and its apex is crowned with a gleaming golden spire. Lush tropical greenery cascades down its lower terraces, surrounding smaller red and gold buildings, domes, and spire-topped structures that form a complex city-like base. Patches of turquoise water are visible among the lower buildings. Sleek, dark futuristic aircraft fly through the sky and among the clouds, circling the immense structure. The atmosphere is one of breathtaking grandeur and ancient-futuristic wonder, bathed in bright, clear daylight. EXTERIOR VIEW.
